top_signals.title: America’s Critical Minerals Push Accelerates
top_signals.summary: Nth Cycle CEO Megan O’Connor joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why China’s control of more than 85% of critical-mineral refining poses a major US supply-chain risk. She breaks down Washington’s push to keep battery materials at home, the government support needed to compete with China, and how Nth Cycle says its technology can bring domestic refining online faster. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Banks Cheer as Deregulation Agenda Spreads to Europe
top_signals.summary:
The US has slashed red tape on Wall Street — now European banks want the same.

Chad Thomas explains why they're increasingly hopeful. (Source: Bloomberg)
